comment: Phase 1 of the gateway work (foundation phase 2): inventory, never convert. The one inventory of mutation entry points, covering the full door set from the phase 2 gate review: transaction constructors inside and outside the store, the store's own transaction-owning methods, raw SQL on any handle (including SQL that controls the transaction), writable connection opens, callbacks handed a handle (projectors, read projections, migrations), the first-contact paths, and every function that receives a raw handle.
